verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document scheduling a task to run automatically, either one-off or recurring, and then report results back. 'Reminders' (poke-docs-25) are a scheduled-notification feature, not scheduled task execution. 'Recipes … set up automations' (poke-docs-28) never mentions time-based or recurring runs, and API triggers from external services (poke-docs-2) would need a user-side scheduler such as cron, so none of these earn credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can schedule recurring or one-off tasks that run automatically and come back to me with results
